title: fix(objectql, metadata-protocol, runtime): a package's export carries the objectExtensions it was installed with, and the owner's export folds no other package's extension
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNTkQJpyt5hDhp8ZSurFMMX)_

Fixes #29872

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：通过 install-local 安装（或代码包里声明）的扩展包，导出时现在会带上它自己的 `objectExtensions`；被扩展对象的拥有者（基础包）导出时，不再把任何其他包的扩展字段并进自己的对象（此前只排除了它自己的 `.custom` 配对包）。`/meta/object`、控制台和数据接口读到的对象不变，仍是合并后的。
- **为什么改**：整部署导出恢复到新环境后，每个包都是 install-local 装进来的；它们再次导出时丢掉扩展字段且不报错，第二跳就静默丢数据（卡片复现 E12）。ADR-0146 D8 第 3 条：包导出只带自己的东西，字段只出现一次。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响包导出读的 per-package 层与导出拼装；registry 新增一个只读方法和一个可选参数，已发布的 `withoutExtensionsOf` 语义不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`（`registeredExtensionsOf`，按目标去重）、`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`（`getObjectExtensionsOf` 与 `isLeftOutExtension`）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`（per-package 层改传 `onlyExtensionsOf`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/packages-export-base-showcase-boot.integration.test.ts -t 29872`，预期 2 passed：扩展包导出带 `objectExtensions`，基础包导出与安装扩展包之前逐字节相同，第二跳再导出不变。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The defect (measured on `origin/main` 21510bba).** `assemblePackageManifest` built a package's `objectExtensions` from the `object_extension` items of the protocol's per-package layer. install-local (and a code package) registers a manifest's `objectExtensions` straight into the registry as `'extend'` contributors (`ObjectQL.registerApp`) and files no item, so such a package exported no extension. Its fields were folded into the OWNER's export instead (the per-package layer left out only the owner's `.custom` pair since #29930). A deployment restored from an export therefore lost every extension field on its next export, and a `.custom` pair installed from its export no longer re-exported its extension.

**Half 1: the extender's export carries its extensions, however they were installed.**
- `SchemaRegistry.getObjectExtensionsOf(packageId)` (new, `@objectstack/objectql`): every `extend` contribution the package makes, read back as the `objectExtensions` entry it was registered from, the inverse of `registerObjectExtension`. `extend` is the key it is filed under; `priority` is written only when it is not the default `200` (the value an entry without one parses to), so a second hop exports the same bytes as the first; `name` and every envelope key (`_packageId`, `_provenance`, ...) are left out.
- `assemblePackageManifest` (`@objectstack/runtime`) appends those entries (`registeredExtensionsOf`) to the per-package layer's `object_extension` items, skipping any target an item already names: a published extension keeps exporting as it is stored (#28574, #29903 pins unchanged). A registry double without the method adds nothing, as before.

**Half 2: the owner's export carries its object without ANY other package's extension** (the seat's carrier note 6605292329).
- `listItems` / `getAllObjects` / `foldObjectExtendersOnto` take an `onlyExtensionsOf` option: only that package's own `extend` contributions fold, every other package's is left out. Both options live in one `ObjectExtensionFoldOptions` and one predicate (`isLeftOutExtension`).
- The per-package layer (`readFlattenedMetaItems`, `layer: 'per-package'`) passes `onlyExtensionsOf` naming the listed package to both the registry list and the overlay-row fold, in place of `withoutExtensionsOf` naming its pair.
- `withoutExtensionsOf` is kept with its meaning: it shipped in the published `@objectstack/objectql@18.3.0` tarball (5 hits in `dist/index.js`, measured with `npm pack`), so removing it would be a narrowing of a published surface. No in-repo caller passes it any more; its unit pin stays.

Served and effective reads are untouched: neither option is passed outside the per-package layer, and the controls in every new pin read `GET /meta/object/NAME` and `GET /meta/object` with every extension folded in.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-extension-field-patches.test.ts`: the #29903 describe now pins `onlyExtensionsOf` (owner listed with neither the pair's nor a third package's extension; an extender folds its own only; an un-extended object is the cached object; byte-equal to a registry with no extender; the stored-body fold) and keeps a `withoutExtensionsOf` case. A new describe pins `getObjectExtensionsOf`: a manifest entry through `ObjectQL.registerApp` comes back as written and parses under the strict `ObjectExtensionSchema`; a stored extension through `registerObjectExtension` comes back with its own priority and re-registers on a fresh registry to a byte-equal served object.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-base-showcase-boot.integration.test.ts` (the shared showcase-boot harness; new top-level describe): an extender registered the way install-local registers it exports its entry; the base's export is byte-identical to its export before the extender was installed, with the pair's extension published beside it, and after a restart; the pair exports its own item only; an extender installed from its own export re-exports the same bytes (the second hop).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-export-bundle-round-trip.dogfood.test.ts`: the first describe asserts the install-local extender's `objectExtensions` by name and in full on the source bundle AND the target bundle, and that the base's object carries the extender's field on neither; the third describe asserts the pair installed on the target from its entry re-exports its extension. The same-inventory pin stays and is green.

## Acceptance notes

- **The inventory pin alone could not see the defect**, and it still cannot see half 1 alone: with half 1 ablated and half 2 in place, the inventory test stayed green (both hops lose the field identically) while the new #29872 dogfood assertions went red. That is why the halves ship together and why the new assertions read the field by name.
- **Dedupe is by the item's `extend` spelling against the registry key.** A stored row spelling a short name that the registry files under a legacy folded key (#28858) would export twice; the save door refuses that spelling (#28834), so no stored row carries it today. Noted, not filed.
- **The pending `.changeset/29903-base-export-without-pair-extension.md`** still says an extension from any other installed package "is still folded into the base's object in the base's export, as before", which this PR makes false. I first corrected it, and `check-empty-changeset` refused (it guards another PR's pending note); I restored it byte-for-byte from the merge base instead, and this PR's changeset carries a "Supersedes, in the same release" paragraph naming that sentence. The seat may still prefer to correct the #29903 note on the release side.
- A code package's export (not in the whole-deployment bundle, which skips `source: 'code'` rows) now also carries its manifest `objectExtensions`, and a platform-owned object's export no longer folds in plugin extensions. Both follow from the same rule.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablations (each: mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor 1 → 0, blob restored == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- **A, half 1** (`packages.ts`: drop the `registeredExtensionsOf` append) against the runtime integration file `-t 29872`: 2 failed. `the extender's export carries its manifest entry: expected undefined to deeply equal [ { extend: 'showcase_task', …(1) } ]`, and the second-hop test the same. Restored.
- **A on dogfood** (runtime resolves from src there): the round-trip file 2 failed / 11 passed: `source: com.dogfood.exportext: expected { extends: [], objectCarries: false } to deeply equal { …(2) }` and `[#29872] target: the pair installed from its entry re-exports its extension: expected undefined to deeply equal [ { …(3) } ]`. Restored.
- **B, half 2** (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`: `onlyExtensionsOf` never set; marker `ablated-29872-b`; metadata-protocol rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `dist`) against the runtime integration file `-t '29872|29903'`: 2 failed / 1 passed. `expected [ 'organization_id', …(11) ] to not include 'acme_billing_code'` and the #29903 `the base's object with the extension live` equality. Restored, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0.
- **C, registry** (`isLeftOutExtension`'s `onlyExtensionsOf` clause → `false`) against `registry-extension-field-patches.test.ts -t 29872`: 4 failed / 4 passed (the four `onlyExtensionsOf` cases). Restored.

</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 547 files / 10827 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 311 passed, 4 skipped files / 22320 passed, 26 skipped tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 538 files / 8599 passed, 19 skipped tests.
- `typecheck` for objectql, metadata-protocol, runtime (incl. each `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- Dogfood `package-export-bundle-round-trip.dogfood.test.ts`: 13/13.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` over the 8 changed source/test files: exit 0 (the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's Lint & Repo Gates).
- `dispatch-gates --commands` (67 families), each run and its exit recorded: 67 exit 0 after three reruns. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 (shallow clone; its pinned fixture commit fetched, then 48 cases pass); `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (seven unbuilt dists: client-react, embedder-openai, knowledge-memory, knowledge-ragflow, service-cluster-redis, service-knowledge, studio; built, then exit 0); `check-empty-changeset` first exited 1 on my edit of the #29903 note (see Acceptance notes; restored, then exit 0).
